args.goal: From the open Invite Vendor side drawer, fill all required fields and invite one vendor without selecting any Categories; then invite a second vendor, search for and select one or more Categories, complete the invite, and stop on the drawer or vendor list showing both successful invites with the second vendor's selected categories.

steps.note: Performs the category-optional and category-mapping interactions that no dedicated catalog step can express.
Confirms the completed invite flow did not leave an application error visible.
